newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing to lease two more AsiaSat 2 transponders.
newsitem.headline: Beijing to lease two more AsiaSat 2 transponders.

text.p: Asia Satellite Telecommunications Co Ltd (AsiaSat) said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with China to lease two additional 36 MHz C Band transponders on its AsiaSat 2 satellite.

AsiaSat said China Broadcasting Film Television Satellite Co Ltd, a unit of the Ministry of Radio, Film and Television, would take the two transponders for providing television services to nine provinces in China.
The ministry currently uses six transponders on AsiaSat 2 and three transponders on AsiaSat 1.
The two C Band transponders are currently broadcasting analogue television to China's Guangdong and Henan provinces.
Those two provinces along with Jiangxi, Liaoning, Hubei, Hunan, Qinghai, Fujian and Inner Mongolia will begin digital broadcasts on AsiaSat 2 in January 1997.
AsiaSat is a unit of Asia Satellite Telecommunications Holdings Ltd.
